name: ed2go (Cengage Work)
category: Online career training / continuing-ed courses (workforce skills)
positioning: ed2go sells online instructor-supported courses and career-training programs, mostly through community colleges/universities and workforce agencies, plus direct to consumers. It sits in Cengage Work, one of three Cengage Group business units (with Infosec).
keyFeatures: Catalog of roughly 750-1,000+ online courses (estimates differ by source)
Career Training Programs delivered via co-branded college partner portals
Many programs approved for WIOA, Voc Rehab, TAA funding (program-specific)
Installment/financing plans via partner schools
Employer/workforce channel through Cengage Work
Infosec cybersecurity training in same unit
pricingNote: Per-course/program prices not found publicly in sources read; vary by college partner. Financing plans exist at partner schools.
hq: Boston, MA (Cengage Group); Cengage Learning Holdings listed in Mason, OH
ownership: Part of Cengage Group (private, PE/debt-holder owned)
headcountSource: Cengage Group overall ~3,800-4,150 per aggregators (Simply Wall St, 2026); ed2go-only figure not found
revenueNote: ed2go standalone revenue not disclosed. Cengage FY2026 earnings-call excerpt: ed2go grew 24% YoY on adjusted cash revenue basis; Cengage digital GAAP revenue ~ $1.2B (whole company, not ed2go).
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026: ~961K visits over 'last 3 months' (so ~320K/month, my division, estimate); global rank ~#34.8K, US ~#7.7K. Label ambiguous on page.
weWin: Purpose-built for laid-off professionals: job search, resume, interview, coaching in one place
WARN-notice and labor-market data for boards
Faster, AI-first reskilling tied to a person's actual job target
theyWin: Large course catalog and long-standing college/workforce-board channel
weNeed: WIOA eligible training provider listings or partner access
partnerIdea: Resell or link ed2go WIOA-approved programs inside NextChapter's reskilling recommendations for laid-off members.
notes: Founding year and ed2go-level headcount/revenue not sourced. Cengage Work/ed2go traffic label ambiguous.

name: Metrix Learning (a Certus company)
positioning: Metrix sells white-labeled eLearning portals (SkillUpAmerica) to workforce boards, state labor departments, libraries and colleges so unemployed, underemployed and dislocated workers can take self-paced courses. Certus (Ridgemont Equity Partners portfolio company) acquired it in 2022.
keyFeatures: Custom SkillUpAmerica portal per community
5,000+ self-paced courses (workplace skills, business, IT)
Course plans driven by labor market and geographic data
Career-pathway alignment to target industries
Outcome/performance tracking
Labor market research and analysis solutions
Used by 100+ workforce boards (per Geographic Solutions webinar page)
Listed on cooperative purchasing contract (NCTCOG TXShare)
pricingNote: Not public; calculator and 'speak to an expert' only.
hq: New York (518 area code; exact HQ not stated)
ownership: Brand of Certus, owned by Ridgemont Equity Partners (PE)
headcountSource: Not found; aggregator figures matched other companies named Certus
revenueNote: Not disclosed; aggregator numbers unreliable (different entities).
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026 shows 115.8K labeled 'last 3 months' (about 38.6K/month, my division, estimate); US rank ~#54K; down 36% MoM.
weWin: Individual-facing job search, resume, interview, coaching, not only courses
WARN-notice data and Program workspace for case managers
Modern AI-first experience
theyWin: Entrenched incumbent in 100+ boards; cooperative contract vehicle
weNeed: Large course library or licensed content
partnerIdea: Position NextChapter job-search/coaching layer alongside Metrix courses in boards that already license Metrix.
notes: Metrix page says it traces to 2008 NY Wired for Education. Revenue/headcount unknown.

name: MedCerts
category: Online healthcare and IT career certification training
positioning: MedCerts sells online, instructor-supported healthcare and IT certification programs to individuals, workforce boards, colleges and military/veteran channels. Owned by Stride, Inc. since 2021.
keyFeatures: Healthcare and IT certification programs
Online with instructor and career support
Workforce board / WIOA, military and college partnerships
Stride career learning (adult) division
Over 50,000 students credentialed (per Stride)
pricingNote: Per-program pricing not read; programs often funded via WIOA/partners.
lastRound: Acquired by Stride, Inc. (announced Nov 2020) for $70M cash plus contingent consideration
headcountSource: Aggregator estimates conflict: ~58 (Datanyze) to ~314 (Growjo); not used
revenueNote: Reported by Stride at acquisition: ~ $19M trailing twelve months to Sept 30, 2020 (+38% YoY), adj. EBITDA ~$4M. Four-plus years stale; current is unknown (aggregators range $10.5M-$64.8M).
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026: 263.7K labeled 'last 3 months' (about 88K/month, my division, estimate); global rank #93.6K; +53% MoM.
weWin: Covers professional/white-collar transitions, not just allied health/IT certs
Job search, resume, interview, coaching tools
WARN data
theyWin: Credentialed healthcare/IT training with workforce funding approvals
partnerIdea: Refer laid-off members interested in healthcare/IT careers to MedCerts programs via a referral arrangement.
notes: Revenue is the only sourced figure but dated 2020.

name: Transfr
category: VR career exploration and skills training
positioning: Transfr sells VR/XR career exploration (Trek) and skills training (Train) simulations to schools, colleges, workforce boards, nonprofits and justice-impacted programs, on a subscription/licensing basis.
keyFeatures: Transfr Trek: 150+ careers in 16 clusters, 50+ Experience a Career simulations in English/Spanish
Transfr Train: 330+ simulations in 8 sectors
Mapped to OSHA, NCCER, ASE standards
Pre-employment programs
Funding support and professional learning
Claims 48 states, 275K+ learners, 1,100+ implementations
Blog content aimed at workforce boards on AI reskilling
pricingNote: Not public; pricing page and demo request only. Subscription/license model.
lastRound: Series C $40M (Sept 2023, reported ABS Capital lead); Series B $35M June 2022 (Lumos Capital)
investors: Lumos Capital Group, ABS Capital (reported), Firework Ventures, Album VC, Spring Tide Capital
headcountSource: Company Feb 2025 press release ~200; Welcome to the Jungle 201-500
trafficNote: Similarweb shows no data for transfr.com (domain is transfrinc.com); not checked.
weWin: Serves adult dislocated professionals; Transfr skews to youth and trades
Job search, coaching, WARN data
Software cost and speed to deploy versus headsets
theyWin: Immersive hands-on simulations in skilled trades/health
Strong funded presence in boards and schools
weNeed: Experiential career previews (could use video or partner VR)
partnerIdea: Offer Transfr Trek as an optional career-exploration step inside Program workspaces for boards that license it.
notes: Founded year not confirmed. Series C date/lead from a single secondary source. Kscope 50-employee estimate rejected.

name: ACT (WorkKeys / ACT Workforce Solutions)
category: Assessment: workforce skills credentials (WorkKeys, NCRC) and job-seeker tools
positioning: ACT sells WorkKeys assessments and the National Career Readiness Certificate to workforce boards, employers, colleges and states, alongside admissions testing. Became a public benefit corporation with Nexus Capital Management investment (announced April 2024).
keyFeatures: WorkKeys assessments and National Career Readiness Certificate
Job profiling for employers
Curriculum/prep (WorkKeys Curriculum)
Used by many AJCs and colleges
Workforce solutions for employers and job seekers
Large national brand
pricingNote: Per-test fees via test centers/partners; not read. Enterprise pricing not public.
lastRound: Nexus Capital Management investment (announced April 2024, terms undisclosed)
investors: Nexus Capital Management; continuing nonprofit retains stake
ownership: Public benefit corporation (formerly 501(c)(3)) with Nexus PE investment; subsidiary Encoura
revenueNote: Form 990 FY ending Aug 2024 total revenue $352.5M (ProPublica). Whole ACT; WorkKeys not broken out. Later FY2025 page showed only $11.5M under the nonprofit entity after restructuring, so not comparable.
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026: ~3.7M, label ambiguous ('last 3 months'); could be a 3-month total (~1.2M/month); +50% MoM. Mostly admissions-test traffic.
weWin: Actual job-search, resume, coaching help for displaced workers
Layoff-specific data and WARN tracking
Modern low-cost delivery, no testing center
theyWin: WorkKeys/NCRC is a recognized credential employers and boards require
weNeed: Skills assessment credibility; a validated assessment or WorkKeys integration
partnerIdea: Guide NextChapter members to WorkKeys/NCRC via local AJCs and show NCRC on profiles.
notes: Revenue is ACT-wide; the FY2025 filing figure conflicts due to restructuring. Traffic label ambiguous.

name: EdITS (COPSystem)
category: Career interest, ability and values assessments
positioning: EdITS (Educational and Industrial Testing Service, San Diego) publishes the COPSystem career assessments: COPS interests, CAPS abilities, COPES values, plus picture and professional versions, sold to schools, colleges, counselors and agencies in digital and paper form.
keyFeatures: COPSystem VIA integrated interests, abilities, values
COPS-P professional level, COPS-PIC picture inventory
Online and paper administration
Translations of directions in several languages
Technical manuals on reliability and validity
EAP sign-in portal
pricingNote: Not listed on site; shop/cart exists.
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026: 8.7K labeled 'last 3 months' (about 2.9K/month, my division, estimate); global rank ~#1.2M.
weWin: End-to-end transition help rather than a single assessment
Modern AI-driven matching
Larger audience and product breadth
theyWin: Decades-old validated assessments with published psychometrics
weNeed: A validated interest/ability assessment or licensed one
partnerIdea: License COPSystem as an optional assessment inside NextChapter and Program workspaces.
notes: Small company with little public financial data; some Buros-listed tests may be out of print.

name: Untapped Solutions
category: Case management CRM and second-chance hiring platform (reentry and nonprofit workforce)
positioning: A software platform for nonprofits, government agencies and employers that combines case management, programs, jobs and hiring, funders and reporting, with a focus on justice-impacted and underrepresented job seekers. Founded by Andre Peart (2025 Echoing Green fellow), shaped by his own reentry experience. This is not Untapped Group (untapped-group.com), a different company.
keyFeatures: Case management: intake, assessments, referrals, services
Program enrollments, milestones, outcomes
Jobs, hiring, interviews, credentials; AI job board matching skills/training
Funder, donor and grant tracking
Outreach: email, segments, forms, events
Report builder and dashboards
Untapped Intelligence AI assistant for routine tasks
Job access inside correctional facilities (CoreCivic partnership)
hq: Atlanta, GA area (per Hypepotamus profile title; not stated on site)
trafficNote: Similarweb Sept 2026 gives global rank ~#7.6M, US ~#2.9M; no visit count; very low traffic.
weWin: Broader candidate product for laid-off professionals (not reentry-only)
WARN/labor data, AI reskilling
Larger content depth
theyWin: Case-management CRM that nonprofits and agencies use daily
weNeed: Deeper case-management and outcomes reporting in Program workspace
partnerIdea: Integrate or co-sell to reentry-serving agencies: Untapped for case management, NextChapter for job search and reskilling.
notes: NAWDP exhibitor page did not list Untapped Solutions; I could not confirm the NAWDP marketplace listing. HQ, founding year and funding conflict or are missing. Customer list from site: Starting Over, Compass Working Capital, LA Conservation Corps, Urban League of St. Louis.
